description: React component for the Observability Webhook Settings Page, enabling configuration of webhook URL, secret, headers, and viewing status/info of the webhook forwarder.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Fetches current webhook configuration and status, updates component state accordingly.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Validates form data and saves the webhook configuration through API call.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the existing webhook configuration after confirmation.

methods.name: handleRedrive
methods.description: Redrives dead letter queue events after user confirmation.

methods.name: handleClearDlq
methods.description: Clears the dead letter queue after user confirmation.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds a new empty header entry to the headers list.

methods.name: updateHeader
methods.description: Updates the key or value of a header at a given index.

methods.name: removeHeader
methods.description: Removes a header at a specified index.
